text:
Goodness is the ornament of prosperity, and restraint of speech is the ornament of valor.
Tranquility is the ornament of knowledge, humility is the ornament of learning, and spending on the deserving is the ornament of wealth.
Absence of anger is the ornament of penance, forgiveness is the ornament of the powerful, and detachment is the ornament of righteousness.
This character is the root of all and the supreme ornament for everyone.
